rows.prediction:
The game piece, a silver metal toy car, is placed on the "Jail" space on the Monopoly board. When a player lands on this space, they are sent to jail and must draw a card from the "Go to Jail" pile. The effect of this on the player's turn is that they lose their turn and cannot make any moves or actions until they draw a card and follow the instructions on the card.

To leave the "Jail" space according to the game rules, the player must draw a card and follow its instructions. If the card instructs the player to draw another card, they must continue drawing cards until they draw a card that allows them to leave jail. If the card instructs the player to pay a fine, they must pay the amount indicated on the card. If the card instructs the player to draw another card, they must follow the instructions on that card as well.

If the game piece were placed on the other part of the "Jail" space, the player would not be sent to jail. Instead, they would land on the "Go" space, which allows them to draw a card from the "Go" pile. The game would proceed as usual, with the player having the opportunity to make moves and actions on their turn.
